infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Spelltrace reads sleep, heart rate, compatible HRV, steps, and workouts you approve. Signing in does not grant this access.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Spelltrace does not write workout or medical records.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Film a bowling spell from a stable side-on or front-on view.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose an existing bowling clip from your library.
